eldoria.npc.text.b88f2e06972b9d8d: How do I use voice chat?
eldoria.npc.text.15be37215f404295: Happy New Year! Welcome to winter Eldoria. Explore the square, visit the merchant and set off on your adventure. Press the button below to enter the survival world.
eldoria.npc.text.61dbf3747211fc80: Press V and select your microphone. By default, hold Caps Lock to talk. Keep the noise down and respect nearby players. Ask the staff if you need help.
eldoria.npc.text.c22a52aee7747e4e: This is a protected lobby: building and flying are reserved for staff. /spawn returns here; /rtp takes you to survival. Use the FTB Chunks map to protect your home.
eldoria.npc.text.d425c2dc656aec8a: Welcome to the winter market! Exchange emeralds for cookies, bread and lanterns. Trading is optional: check the price first.
eldoria.npc.text.04461d71746a6956: Casino Coin is a separate casino token. Buy for 100 in-game $, sell for 85 in-game $. For another quantity use /casino buy number or /casino sell number. Only Casino Coin can be wagered. Your website wallet is not used here.
